description: Welcome to the official campaign website for Jeff Monroe, Republican candidate for Alabama House District 37. With over 45 years of experience in public safety and two decades in local government, Jeff is a proven leader who understands the needs of our communities. Explore his platform, learn more about his background, and find out how you can get involved in building a stronger future for District 37.
